exercise_groups.group_title: DẠNG 1: CHIA ĐỘNG TỪ TRONG NGOẶC (20 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Cho dạng đúng của động từ trong ngoặc để hoàn thành các câu điều kiện sau:

questions.prompt: 1. If it (rain) [blank] tomorrow, we will cancel the outdoor picnic.
answers: rains
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: Mệnh đề If chia hiện tại đơn (it rains), mệnh đề chính dùng will + V0.

questions.prompt: 2. If I (be) [blank] you, I would take that opportunity immediately.
answers: were
was
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2: Mệnh đề If dùng 'were' (hoặc was) cho giả định trái ngược hiện tại.

questions.prompt: 3. If they had checked the map, they (not / get) [blank] lost in the mountains yesterday.
answers: would not have got
wouldn't have got
would not have gotten
wouldn't have gotten
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: Mệnh đề chính chia would not have + V3 (got/gotten).

questions.prompt: 4. If she (study) [blank] harder, she will pass the entrance exam.
answers: studies
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: Mệnh đề chính có 'will pass', mệnh đề If chia hiện tại đơn (studies).

questions.prompt: 5. If he (have) [blank] free time this weekend, he would go fishing with us.
answers: had
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2: Mệnh đề chính có 'would go', mệnh đề If chia quá khứ đơn (had).

questions.prompt: 6. If you (not / leave) [blank] now, you will be late for the flight.
answers: do not leave
don't leave
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: Phủ định hiện tại đơn với 'you' dùng don't / do not leave.

questions.prompt: 7. If we (know) [blank] about your situation earlier, we could have helped you.
answers: had known
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: Mệnh đề chính có 'could have helped', mệnh đề If chia quá khứ hoàn thành (had known).

questions.prompt: 8. What would you do if you (find) [blank] a wallet full of money on the street?
answers: found
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2: Mệnh đề chính có 'would you do', mệnh đề If chia quá khứ đơn (found).

questions.prompt: 9. If the weather (be) [blank] fine yesterday, we would have gone hiking.
answers: had been
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: Trái ngược quá khứ (yesterday), mệnh đề If chia had been.

questions.prompt: 10. If people (use) [blank] public transport more, air pollution will decrease.
answers: use
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: Chủ ngữ 'people' số nhiều đi với V0 (use).

questions.prompt: 11. If I had enough money right now, I (buy) [blank] a new laptop.
answers: would buy
could buy
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2: Giả định trái với hiện tại (right now), mệnh đề chính dùng would buy.

questions.prompt: 12. If she had listened to her parents' advice, she (not / make) [blank] that mistake last night.
answers: would not have made
wouldn't have made
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: Mệnh đề If chia had listened, mệnh đề chính dùng wouldn't have made.

questions.prompt: 13. If you mix red and white, you (get) [blank] pink.
answers: get
will get
questions.explanation: Sự thật hiển nhiên / quy luật khoa học (Câu điều kiện loại 0 hoặc loại 1): dùng get hoặc will get.

questions.prompt: 14. If he (drive) [blank] more carefully, he wouldn't have had an accident two days ago.
answers: had driven
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: Trái ngược quá khứ (two days ago), mệnh đề If chia had driven.

questions.prompt: 15. If I (know) [blank] his phone number, I would call him to ask for help.
answers: knew
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2: Mệnh đề chính có 'would call', mệnh đề If chia quá khứ đơn (knew).

questions.prompt: 16. If you don't water these flowers, they (die) [blank] in a few days.
answers: will die
die
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: Mệnh đề If chia hiện tại đơn (don't water), mệnh đề chính chia will die.

questions.prompt: 17. If they (start) [blank] the project earlier, they would have finished it on time last week.
answers: had started
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ hoàn thành (had started).

questions.prompt: 18. If she (speak) [blank] English fluently, she could get a better job now.
answers: spoke
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2: Trái với hiện tại (now), mệnh đề If chia quá khứ đơn (spoke).

questions.prompt: 19. If you (touch) [blank] that hot stove, you will burn your hand.
answers: touch
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: Mệnh đề If chia hiện tại đơn (touch).

questions.prompt: 20. If we had arrived at the cinema 10 minutes earlier, we (not / miss) [blank] the beginning of the movie.
answers: would not have missed
wouldn't have missed
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: Mệnh đề chính chia would not have missed.

exercise_groups.group_title: DẠNG 2: TRẮC NGHIỆM CHỌN ĐÁP ÁN ĐÚNG (20 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Chọn phương án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) để hoàn thành mỗi câu sau:

questions.prompt: 1. If I ________ enough money, I would buy a new car.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính dùng 'would buy' (Loại 2) ➔ Mệnh đề If dùng quá khứ đơn 'had'.

questions.prompt: 2. If you ________ hard, you will pass the upcoming exam.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính dùng 'will pass' (Loại 1) ➔ Mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn với 'you' là 'study'.

questions.prompt: 3. If they had checked the engine carefully, the car ________ down on the highway.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề If dùng 'had checked' (Loại 3) ➔ Mệnh đề chính dùng 'wouldn't have broken'.

questions.prompt: 4. Unless you ________ quiet, the baby will wake up.
questions.explanation: Unless = If ... not (đã mang nghĩa phủ định) nên mệnh đề sau unless dùng thể khẳng định 'keep'.

questions.prompt: 5. If I ________ you, I would tell the truth to the teacher.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc khuyên nhủ ở câu điều kiện loại 2: 'If I were you'.

questions.prompt: 6. What will happen if we ________ taking care of the environment?
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1 với 'What will happen' ➔ Mệnh đề If chia hiện tại đơn phủ định 'don't start'.

questions.prompt: 7. If she ________ her keys yesterday, she wouldn't have been locked out.
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu 'yesterday' và mệnh đề chính loại 3 ➔ Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ hoàn thành 'hadn't lost'.

questions.prompt: 8. You can't enter the room unless you ________ a password.
questions.explanation: Sau Unless ở hiện tại dùng thể khẳng định V0 'have'.

questions.prompt: 9. If he ________ so fast, he wouldn't have crashed into the tree.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính loại 3 'wouldn't have crashed' ➔ Mệnh đề If dùng quá khứ hoàn thành 'hadn't driven'.

questions.prompt: 10. If I have free time this afternoon, I ________ you with your homework.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: Mệnh đề If chia hiện tại đơn (have) ➔ Mệnh đề chính chia 'will help'.

questions.prompt: 11. If the sun ________, we will go for a walk in the park.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: Chủ ngữ 'the sun' số ít đi với động từ thêm -s 'shines'.

questions.prompt: 12. If she had studied for the quiz, she ________ it easily.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: Mệnh đề If chia had studied ➔ Mệnh đề chính dùng 'would have passed'.

questions.prompt: 13. I ________ to the party if I had been invited.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề If chia 'had been invited' (Loại 3) ➔ Mệnh đề chính dùng 'would have gone'.

questions.prompt: 14. If you press this button, the machine ________ working.
questions.explanation: Sự thật hiển nhiên / quy luật máy móc (Zero conditional): If + hiện tại đơn, hiện tại đơn ('starts').

questions.prompt: 15. Unless he ________ hard, he won't get a promotion.
questions.explanation: Sau Unless ở hiện tại dùng thể khẳng định: 'he works'.

questions.prompt: 16. If I lived near the sea, I ________ swimming every morning.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2: Mệnh đề If chia lived ➔ Mệnh đề chính chia 'would go'.

questions.prompt: 17. If the flight ________ delayed, we would have reached the hotel before midnight.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính dùng 'would have reached' (Loại 3) ➔ Mệnh đề If dùng 'hadn't been'.

questions.prompt: 18. What ________ you do if you won a million dollars today?
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ đơn 'won' (Loại 2) ➔ Câu hỏi dùng 'What would you do'.

questions.prompt: 19. She wouldn't have been late for work if her alarm clock ________ off.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ hoàn thành 'had gone'.

questions.prompt: 20. Unless it ________, we will play football in the yard.
questions.explanation: Sau Unless dùng khẳng định: 'Unless it rains'.

exercise_groups.group_title: DẠNG 3: VIẾT LẠI CÂU - NHÓM A: DÙNG 'IF' (30 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Dựa trên tình huống thực tế cho trước, viết lại thành câu điều kiện bắt đầu bằng 'If':

questions.prompt: 1. Factories dump waste into rivers, so a lot of fish die.
answers: didn't dump waste into rivers, a lot of fish wouldn't die
didn't dump waste into rivers, a lot of fish wouldn't die.
did not dump waste into rivers, a lot of fish would not die.
questions.explanation: Tình huống hiện tại ➔ Viết câu điều kiện loại 2, lùi thì và đổi sang phủ định.

questions.prompt: 2. People use plastic bags, so oceans are full of plastic garbage.
answers: didn't use plastic bags, oceans wouldn't be full of plastic garbage
didn't use plastic bags, oceans wouldn't be full of plastic garbage.
did not use plastic bags, oceans would not be full of plastic garbage.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại ➔ Loại 2: If people didn't use plastic bags, oceans wouldn't be full of plastic garbage.

questions.prompt: 3. I don't walk to school, so I don't save a lot of money.
answers: walked to school, I would save a lot of money
walked to school, I would save a lot of money.
questions.explanation: Phủ định hiện tại (don't walk, don't save) ➔ Khẳng định loại 2: If I walked to school, I would save a lot of money.

questions.prompt: 4. People build too many houses, so land for farming decreases.
answers: didn't build too many houses, land for farming wouldn't decrease
didn't build too many houses, land for farming wouldn't decrease.
did not build too many houses, land for farming would not decrease.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If people didn't build too many houses, land for farming wouldn't decrease.

questions.prompt: 5. The Earth becomes hotter, so the polar ice cap melts.
answers: didn't become hotter, the polar ice cap wouldn't melt
didn't become hotter, the polar ice cap wouldn't melt.
did not become hotter, the polar ice cap would not melt.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If the Earth didn't become hotter, the polar ice cap wouldn't melt.

questions.prompt: 6. The polar ice cap melts, so sea level rises.
answers: didn't melt, sea level wouldn't rise
didn't melt, sea level wouldn't rise.
did not melt, sea level would not rise.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If the polar ice cap didn't melt, sea level wouldn't rise.

questions.prompt: 7. We don't use recycled products, so we don't help the environment.
answers: used recycled products, we would help the environment
used recycled products, we would help the environment.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If we used recycled products, we would help the environment.

questions.prompt: 8. We breathe polluted air, so we suffer from lung diseases.
answers: didn't breathe polluted air, we wouldn't suffer from lung diseases
didn't breathe polluted air, we wouldn't suffer from lung diseases.
did not breathe polluted air, we would not suffer from lung diseases.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If we didn't breathe polluted air, we wouldn't suffer from lung diseases.

questions.prompt: 9. People don't often cycle, so there is a lot of air pollution.
answers: often cycled, there wouldn't be a lot of air pollution
often cycled, there wouldn't be a lot of air pollution.
often cycled, there would not be a lot of air pollution.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If people often cycled, there wouldn't be a lot of air pollution.

questions.prompt: 10. You don't write on both sides, so you waste your paper.
answers: wrote on both sides, you wouldn't waste your paper
wrote on both sides, you wouldn't waste your paper.
wrote on both sides, you would not waste your paper.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If you wrote on both sides, you wouldn't waste your paper.

questions.prompt: 11. I can't call her because I don't have her number.
answers: had her number, I could call her
had her number, I could call her.
had her number, I would be able to call her.
questions.explanation: Có 'because' ➔ Viết mệnh đề sau 'because' trước: If I had her number, I could call her.

questions.prompt: 12. He doesn't like sweet food, so he didn't try the dessert.
answers: liked sweet food, he would have tried the dessert
liked sweet food, he would have tried the dessert.
had liked sweet food, he would have tried the dessert.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện hỗn hợp (hiện tại ➔ quá khứ) hoặc loại 3: If he liked sweet food, he would have tried the dessert.

questions.prompt: 13. She doesn't practice enough, so she can't play the violin well.
answers: practiced enough, she could play the violin well
practiced enough, she could play the violin well.
practised enough, she could play the violin well.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If she practiced enough, she could play the violin well.

questions.prompt: 14. She doesn't know the way to the concert, so she's not going.
answers: knew the way to the concert, she would go
knew the way to the concert, she would go.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If she knew the way to the concert, she would go.

questions.prompt: 15. We don't have enough time, so we can't travel to Europe.
answers: had enough time, we could travel to Europe
had enough time, we could travel to Europe.
had enough time, we would be able to travel to Europe.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If we had enough time, we could travel to Europe.

questions.prompt: 16. They don't have enough skills, so they can't finish the project.
answers: had enough skills, they could finish the project
had enough skills, they could finish the project.
had enough skills, they would be able to finish the project.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If they had enough skills, they could finish the project.

questions.prompt: 17. He doesn't live close to his gym, so he always arrives late.
answers: lived close to his gym, he wouldn't always arrive late
lived close to his gym, he wouldn't always arrive late.
lived close to his gym, he would not always arrive late.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If he lived close to his gym, he wouldn't always arrive late.

questions.prompt: 18. I don't have my bike today, so I'm walking.
answers: had my bike today, I wouldn't walk
had my bike today, I wouldn't walk.
had my bike today, I wouldn't be walking.
had my bike today, I would not walk.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If I had my bike today, I wouldn't walk (hoặc wouldn't be walking).

questions.prompt: 19. She didn't bring her coat, so she got cold.
answers: had brought her coat, she wouldn't have got cold
had brought her coat, she wouldn't have got cold.
had brought her coat, she wouldn't have gotten cold.
had brought her coat, she would not have got cold.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ ➔ Loại 3: If she had brought her coat, she wouldn't have got cold.

questions.prompt: 20. They didn't read the manual, so they made a mistake.
answers: had read the manual, they wouldn't have made a mistake
had read the manual, they wouldn't have made a mistake.
had read the manual, they would not have made a mistake.
questions.explanation: Loại 3: If they had read the manual, they wouldn't have made a mistake.

questions.prompt: 21. He wasn't at the workshop, so he missed the practical session.
answers: had been at the workshop, he wouldn't have missed the practical session
had been at the workshop, he wouldn't have missed the practical session.
had been at the workshop, he would not have missed the practical session.
questions.explanation: wasn't ➔ had been (Loại 3): If he had been at the workshop, he wouldn't have missed the practical session.

questions.prompt: 22. He didn't take the bus, so he was late.
answers: had taken the bus, he wouldn't have been late
had taken the bus, he wouldn't have been late.
had taken the bus, he would not have been late.
questions.explanation: Loại 3: If he had taken the bus, he wouldn't have been late.

questions.prompt: 23. The weather was rainy, so we didn't go hiking.
answers: hadn't been rainy, we would have gone hiking
hadn't been rainy, we would have gone hiking.
had not been rainy, we would have gone hiking.
questions.explanation: was ➔ hadn't been (Loại 3): If the weather hadn't been rainy, we would have gone hiking.

questions.prompt: 24. She didn't study for the quiz, so she failed.
answers: had studied for the quiz, she wouldn't have failed
had studied for the quiz, she wouldn't have failed.
had studied for the quiz, she would not have failed.
questions.explanation: Loại 3: If she had studied for the quiz, she wouldn't have failed.

questions.prompt: 25. The supervisor didn't approve the plan, so we can't begin the task.
answers: had approved the plan, we could begin the task
had approved the plan, we could begin the task.
had approved the plan, we would be able to begin the task.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện hỗn hợp (Quá khứ ➔ Hiện tại): If the supervisor had approved the plan, we could begin the task.

questions.prompt: 26. I didn't understand the guidelines, so I couldn't complete the project.
answers: had understood the guidelines, I could have completed the project
had understood the guidelines, I could have completed the project.
had understood the guidelines, I would have been able to complete the project.
questions.explanation: Loại 3: If I had understood the guidelines, I could have completed the project.

questions.prompt: 27. She forgot her keys, so she was locked out.
answers: hadn't forgotten her keys, she wouldn't have been locked out
hadn't forgotten her keys, she wouldn't have been locked out.
had not forgotten her keys, she would not have been locked out.
questions.explanation: Loại 3: If she hadn't forgotten her keys, she wouldn't have been locked out.

questions.prompt: 28. We didn't make reservations, so we couldn't dine at the restaurant.
answers: had made reservations, we could have dined at the restaurant
had made reservations, we could have dined at the restaurant.
had made reservations, we would have been able to dine at the restaurant.
questions.explanation: Loại 3: If we had made reservations, we could have dined at the restaurant.

questions.prompt: 29. He didn't bring his sketchbook, so he couldn't draw at the event.
answers: had brought his sketchbook, he could have drawn at the event
had brought his sketchbook, he could have drawn at the event.
had brought his sketchbook, he would have been able to draw at the event.
questions.explanation: Loại 3: If he had brought his sketchbook, he could have drawn at the event.

questions.prompt: 30. He didn't study for the test, so he failed.
answers: had studied for the test, he wouldn't have failed
had studied for the test, he wouldn't have failed.
had studied for the test, he would not have failed.
questions.explanation: Loại 3: If he had studied for the test, he wouldn't have failed.

exercise_groups.group_title: DẠNG 3: VIẾT LẠI CÂU - NHÓM B: DÙNG 'UNLESS' (5 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Viết lại các câu sau bằng cách sử dụng 'Unless' (Unless = If ... not):

questions.prompt: 31. If you don't water these plants, they will die.
answers: water these plants, they will die
water these plants, they will die.
questions.explanation: Unless = If ... not ➔ Bỏ don't, giữ nguyên động từ water: Unless you water these plants, they will die.

questions.prompt: 32. If he doesn't hurry, he will miss the train.
answers: hurries, he will miss the train
hurries, he will miss the train.
questions.explanation: Bỏ doesn't, động từ chia theo ngôi số ít (hurry ➔ hurries): Unless he hurries, he will miss the train.

questions.prompt: 33. I won't go to the party if she doesn't invite me.
answers: invites me, I won't go to the party
invites me, I won't go to the party.
invites me, I will not go to the party.
questions.explanation: Đảo mệnh đề Unless lên đầu: Unless she invites me, I won't go to the party.

questions.prompt: 34. If you don't study hard, you won't pass the final test.
answers: study hard, you won't pass the final test
study hard, you won't pass the final test.
study hard, you will not pass the final test.
questions.explanation: Bỏ don't: Unless you study hard, you won't pass the final test.

questions.prompt: 35. If it doesn't stop raining, we can't go for a walk.
answers: stops raining, we can't go for a walk
stops raining, we can't go for a walk.
stops raining, we cannot go for a walk.
questions.explanation: Bỏ doesn't, động từ chia thêm -s: Unless it stops raining, we can't go for a walk.
